text: Your best ideas don't arrive in a straight line.
So why present them one flat slide at a time? Next. Next. Next. By slide twelve, nobody remembers how it all connects.
Now put your whole story in one place. One infinite canvas, where every idea has a home, and you can see how they connect.
This is GlideDeck. Presentations that move.
A million times deeper, still razor sharp.
Pull back, and everyone knows exactly where they are.
In a Harvard study, audiences rated zooming presentations more engaging and more persuasive than slides.
Got a PowerPoint? Drop it in.
One click makes it a spiral, an orbit, a carousel.
Animate a slide in one click.
Then share it as a web page, a PDF, or back to PowerPoint.
No account. No cloud. No subscription. Free, open source, and it runs entirely on your computer.
Stop flipping. Start flying. GlideDeck. Free on GitHub.
